        <payload><?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>public</access><active>true</active><api_name>global.HRSCGlobalUtils</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description>HR Service Center functions that cannot be executed within the scoped application are placed here:&#13;
1) setJournalEntry()</description><name>HRSCGlobalUtils</name><script><![CDATA[var HRSCGlobalUtils = Class.create();
HRSCGlobalUtils.prototype = {
    initialize: function() {
    },

	writeJournal: function(table, sys_id, journal_input, message, user_name) {
		gr = new GlideRecord(table);
		gr.addQuery('sys_id', sys_id);
		gr.query();
		if (gr.next()) {
			gr[journal_input].setJournalEntry(message, user_name);
			gr.update();
			gs.info("HRSCGlobalUtils: Adding '"+message+"' on comment field of table HR Resquest for record "+sys_id+" by user " +user_name);
		}
	},

    type: 'HRSCGlobalUtils'
};]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>bcrepeault_admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2024-05-13 12:27:18</sys_created_on><sys_customer_update>false</sys_customer_update><sys_id>c0e20fc387468e10124b7777dabb3511</sys_id><sys_mod_count>8</sys_mod_count><sys_name>HRSCGlobalUtils</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Global" source="global">global</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_replace_on_upgrade>false</sys_replace_on_upgrade><sys_scope display_value="Global">global</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_c0e20fc387468e10124b7777dabb3511</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>bcrepeault_admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2024-05-13 13:29:06</sys_updated_on><u_fx_inactive>false</u_fx_inactive><u_source/><u_target/></sys_script_include></record_update></payload>
